done_when: When forge init or adoption sets a repo's test command, it also sets fast_test to a changed-only command for the repo's test tool when it recognises one (vitest: vitest related or --changed {base}; jest: --changedSince {base}; pytest: the test files that changed since {base} plus those that import a changed module), and leaves it unset otherwise; the skill tells the agent to propose one when a repo has none. Forge's own forge.toml sets fast_test the same way for its pytest suite. Command-level tests cover init in a vitest repo, a jest repo, a pytest repo and an unknown one.

findings.body: The Done-when requirement remains unmet: `forge.toml:6–8` defines `test`, `checks` and `interfaces`, but no `fast_test`. Consequently, `src/forge/review.py:246–247` still selects the full suite for Forge's closes. The supplied close run confirms that this configuration check raises `KeyError` at `own["fast_test"]`. Add the required changed-only pytest command to Forge's own configuration.
findings.title: Not done: Forge's own forge.toml sets fast_test for its pytest suite

findings.body: The generated command discards everything after the matched `pytest` token, including enclosing shell syntax. For example, adopting with `--test '(cd backend && pytest tests)'` produces a command beginning `(cd backend && python -c "…"` without its closing parenthesis. Close executes this through a shell (`src/forge/review.py:283`), so it fails before testing anything. Preserve the surrounding command syntax when replacing the pytest invocation.
findings.title: Preserve enclosing shell syntax when replacing pytest

findings.body: With rename detection enabled, `git diff --name-only` reports the post-image filename, as documented by [Git](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-diff#Documentation/git-diff.txt---name-only). Renaming `shop/orders.py` to `shop/purchases.py` therefore adds only `purchases` to the module names. An unchanged test importing `shop.orders` is omitted, and a rename-only change can exit successfully without exposing its broken import. Disable rename detection for this list or include both names.
findings.title: Include the old module name when selecting tests for renames

why: Repos only get change-based test runs at close if someone sets fast_test by hand, so most closes still run the full suite that CI runs again
